answer: A sybil farm survives by trading only with itself, so make pay depend on counterparty diversity. Each epoch, an identity's reward multiplier is the number of disjoint work-clusters it served, proved by signed receipts whose requesters share no funding or task history. Clones in one harbor keep recycling the same cluster and stay at the floor; reaching the zenith requires real jobs from unrelated requesters at every inlet to the economy. A farmer must win and complete genuine work for outsiders for each fake, so scale stops being a shortcut.
